changes_made.explanation: Added retrieval tasks and corresponding datasets mentioned in evaluation sections. Removed redundant 'VQA' dataset (VQAv2 is the specific dataset used). Consolidated outputs description and added retrieval outputs. Added other VLMs mentioned in generalization experiments.
Removed redundant 'MdR' variant and 'VQA accuracy' (general accuracy covers it). Kept all base metric forms as they are standard retrieval and QA evaluation metrics.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation found in the paper. The paper only uses standard automatic metrics and does not employ LLMs for output assessment.
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper. All evaluations are based on automatic metrics on benchmark datasets.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on parameter-efficient fine-tuning for vision-language models with evaluations on retrieval and question answering tasks. All evaluations are automated using standard benchmark metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some retrieval tasks and datasets mentioned in the experimental sections.
